identifyTitle: How would you like to identify yourself?
identifySubtitle: Choose an option and enter the data to locate your stay.
cpfMethodSubtitle: Enter the 11 digits of the document
cpfHelper: Type the 11 digits of the document. The kiosk will search the selected hotel for an open reservation.
reservationHelper: Type the booking code for the open reservation you want to continue.
qrScannerBody: Place the reservation QR code in front of the camera. The kiosk will validate the token automatically and continue if the reservation is open.
qrScannerReady: Camera ready. Show the QR code to continue.
qrScannerError: We could not start the camera right now.
qrNotFoundBody: We could not validate the reservation token. Please try again or use another identification method.
notFoundCpfBody: We could not find an open reservation for this CPF at the selected hotel. Please verify the number and try again.
notFoundReservationBody: We could not find an open reservation for this reservation number at the selected hotel. Please verify the code and try again.
notFoundBody: We could not locate your stay details with the provided data. Please check your code or go to reception.
genericLookupBody: We could not complete the lookup right now. Please try again or go to reception.
confirmationSubtitle: Review the booking details before facial verification.
reservationEligible: This reservation is ready to continue.
reservationNotEligible: This reservation still requires reception validation.
summaryVisualBody: This reservation has been matched and is ready for the next step.
contactSubtitle: Review the data we have on file before we submit it to the hotel system.
contactSummaryHint: You can edit any field before moving ahead.
contactErrorBody: We could not confirm the contact details right now.
termsSubtitle: Please review the stay rules and the privacy agreement before proceeding.
termsRuleOneBody: Guests agree to respect hotel policies and shared spaces during the stay.
termsRuleTwoBody: Late cancellations or no-shows may be charged according to the reservation policy.
termsRuleThreeBody: The use of common areas follows the hotel's access and safety rules.
termsAcceptLabel: I accept the terms and conditions
termsBiometryLabel: I agree to biometric validation where available
termsErrorBody: We could not register the terms right now.
paymentSubtitle: Choose how you would like to settle the reservation balance.
paymentErrorBody: We could not complete the payment right now.
successSubtitle: Your room has been assigned and your key is ready to use.
successCopy: Thank you for choosing our kiosk. You can now proceed to your room.
recoveryPaymentBody: The selected payment method was declined. Please choose another method and try again.
recoveryBiometryBody: We could not complete the biometric step. Please try again or ask reception for help.
recoveryDocumentBody: We could not validate the document details. Please review the data and try again.
recoveryReservationBody: This reservation cannot continue automatically right now. Please ask reception for assistance.
recoveryGenericBody: Something interrupted the flow. Please try again or contact reception.
